# A01-S108: Artificial stupidity

Extract from the operator’s source text. Transport metadata, signatures and marked context omitted.

[…]

In another email, I have linked my working draft for an AI literature project. It’s about writing Marcel Proust with AI. Since it’s not possible at a high enough level with current language models, I’m using a number of poetic-mathematical techniques to show how an AI itself would approach the task. It’s of course a lesson in artificial stupidity :-)
